'''Quadrant F-76''' was a section of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was the location of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] counter-terrorism operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was also the main distribution division of [[CoruFresh]].
